kept.title: Sidewalk clearing starts at 2 cm of snow and can take about 12 hours
kept.detail: According to the City's report, sidewalk clearing begins once 2 cm of snow has built up. A full clearing cycle typically takes approximately 12 hours, so sidewalks may not be cleared yet shortly after a snowfall.

cites.quote: the City begins sidewalk clearing once snow accumulation reaches 2 cm.
City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.

kept.title: Public laneways are salted but not plowed
kept.detail: The City's service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after snowfall ends; snow plowing is not provided. The report also says priority transit stops chosen by the TTC got focused clearing, but the data does not show whether the stops near this location are on that list.

cites.quote: public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
the TTC provided a list of priority stops and routes, which helped focus clearing efforts on high- traffic and higher-risk locations.
